question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Concieve ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**Conceive**" means to form or develop in the mind, to imagine or understand. (मन में बनना या विकसित होना, कल्पना करना या समझना) • **For example**: *It's fascinating to watch an artist conceive a new painting from their imagination.* • The correct spelling of the word is with the letter "**i**" after the letter "**e**". • The incorrect spelling "Concieve" is a common misspelling of the word. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Detect**" means to discover or identify something. (किसी चीज़ की खोज या पहचान करना) • "**Predict**" means to forecast or estimate something based on available information. (उपलब्ध जानकारी के आधार पर किसी चीज़ का पूर्वानुमान या अनुमान लगाना) • "**Stimulate**" means to encourage or excite something to happen. (किसी चीज़ को घटित होने के लिए प्रोत्साहित या उत्साहित करना) 35:T9ed, The correct answer is: **went on the rampage**
